details: App loads fine, however using the "test" feature, none of the video formats load at all.  When I try to run the screensaver, either through "test", or through starting the screensaver in Glasshouse, I am presented with about ~1s of black screen, before reverting back to whatever the screen was previously on.  https://github.com/aabytt/custom-screensaver-aerial/issues/46  This issue indicated that 4K SDR and 1080 H264 worked fine, however this is not the case on my setup - none of the video formats work at all when applied as a screensaver.  If I go to Playlist, I am able to play individual videos OK (1080 SDR or 4K SDR), however I am not able to play them as a screensaver.  This app looks great, and I would really like to use it on my TV - so if I can provide any data to help this run on WebOS 24, please let me know!
The Clock should move position with every Video change to prevent burn in.
Pressing test takes a couple secs and reports “sucess!”, but nothing happens. After uninstalling the app, the original screensaver no longer triggers. Any ideas?

The 4k 240FPS (HEVC) format does not play, as its label warns.  The TEST button did not work at first. I turned on Autostart, then pressed TEST: LG's stock screensaver started, and the result said "Success!". Autostart acts only at the next boot, and I had not pressed "Apply until reboot". Before Apply, `getAppInfo` for `com.webos.app.screensaver` still reported `"type":"flutter"`, so the app can detect this case. After Apply, TEST started Aerial.  A UI suggestion: show a warning on TEST when Aerial is not applied, or apply at once when Autostart is turned on.
